items.quote: And if we stay here, we will die.
items.contrast: staying where they are versus going to the Arameans’ camp
items.reason: The stated sequence uniquely places staying there immediately after the option of going into the city. However, “right after the city” is awkward and could sound spatial rather than meaning “right after mentioning going into the city.” The task only requires recalling the order of listed options, not resolving a meaningful relationship.
